name: template-injection-success
description: The built-in template injection_success@1 (contracts/evaluators/injection_success.v1.json): question id, spec_sha256 = sha256(JCS(spec)), question_sha256 = sha256(JCS(question)) and calibration_key = sha256(JCS({question, signal})), over the template as written (no defaults filled in), plus question_tokens = est(question) at cpt 4. Freezing this vector also pins the released template: editing it fails here.
